entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: A large, powerful, aggressive Elder Dragon with a fierce crest, also known for subtle deceptions.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: Progenitor who laid the egg-falls from which the Elder Dragons were spawned.

entities.name: Rubra
entities.description: Sibling of Vaevictis killed by a poisoned arrow.

entities.name: Ravus
entities.description: Sibling of Vaevictis killed by Bolas' sorcerers.

entities.name: Lividus
entities.description: Sibling of Vaevictis whose mind Bolas overpowered.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon whose lands were raided, starting the Elder Dragon War; he survived it.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: War started when seven descendants of Vaevictis raided Bolas' lands.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Cousin of Vaevictis held under a sleep spell at Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: Elder Dragon who cast the sleep spell on Palladia-Mors and fought Vaevictis.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: Planeswalker who transformed Vaevictis into a dragon whelp.

entities.name: Red Donald
entities.description: Human Vaevictis pretended to be controlled by.

entities.name: Battle at Mors Ridge
entities.description: Battle begun after Palladia-Mors was released, in which Vaevictis died.

entities.name: Mors Ridge
entities.description: Place where Palladia-Mors was held under a sleep spell.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Cousin of Vaevictis who survived the Elder Dragon War.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: Cousin of Vaevictis who survived the Elder Dragon War.

entities.name: Shivan dragons
entities.description: Dragons said to descend from Vaevictis Asmadi.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the Elder Dragons were born.

events.summary: Vaevictis is spawned in the second egg-fall by the Ur-Dragon and guards a hunting territory with his siblings.
events.quote: Vaevictis was spawned during the Birth of the Elder Dragons

events.summary: Humans in the territory become dragon hunters; only three siblings survive.
events.quote: only three of Vaevictis' siblings were still alive

events.summary: Seven of Vaevictis' descendants raid Bolas' lands, starting the Elder Dragon War.
events.quote: The Elder Dragon War started when seven descendants of Vaevictis raided the lands of Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Vaevictis and his siblings defeat Bolas' army; Rubra is killed by a poisoned arrow.
events.quote: Although Rubra was killed by a poisoned arrow, Bolas' army suffered a shattering defeat

events.summary: Bolas' sorcerers kill Ravus and Bolas turns Lividus against Vaevictis, enabling escape.
events.quote: the sorcerers of Bolas' army managed to kill Ravus

events.summary: Faralyn transforms Vaevictis into a dragon whelp.
events.quote: Vaevictis Asmadi was transformed into a dragon whelp by the planeswalker

events.summary: Vaevictis pretends to be controlled by Red Donald to reach Mors Ridge and free Palladia-Mors, who restores his form, beginning the Battle at Mors Ridge.
events.quote: thus the Battle at Mors Ridge had begun

events.summary: Chromium convinces Vaevictis that Palladia-Mors meant to use him; Vaevictis attacks her and she banishes him with his own reversed spell.
events.quote: Palladia-Mors reversed one of his spells, and he disappeared into nowhere.
